Type-safety narrowing documented: the native useVehicleState `.state` is typed `VehicleState | string | null` (offline responses can be a bare status string); the web call site is `any`. Narrowed once (`rawState != null && typeof rawState === 'object' ? rawState : null`) to VehicleState|null so a bare-string state yields the same nullish (empty) result the web produces. outsideTemp is non-null whenever hasData is true; `tempC = outsideTemp ?? 0` is an unreachable narrowing fallback keeping the icon/value reads strictly typed. The L62 coordinate guard `state?.latitude != null && state?.longitude != null` narrows state to non-null before reading state.latitude/longitude.toFixed(2).

Unavailable-on-native affordances intentionally omitted + documented: WidgetShell's web pulse-on-data-change box-shadow glow (justUpdated/prevUpdatedAt useEffect, source WidgetShell L60-80/116-118) is a CSS shadow transition with no native analog; the help-tooltip / pin-button / actions / noPadding / query header slots are unused by this widget and not modeled. RN raw-text safety: every dynamic value lives inside <AppText>; the lat/long guard is rendered as `cond ? <AppText> : null` (never a stray string node).

Only RN primitives (View/StyleSheet + AppText) + the converted DataFreshness port + the useVehicles/useVehicleState parity hooks + theme tokens are used; no DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide, react-router, or old web UI components are imported.
